correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and boundaries are proved analytically. P=alpha I+beta G, strict G positivity, exact Green rank-one minor cancellation, SPD principal minors and ratio-witness strict inequalities establish failure for every n>=3, theta>1, h>0. LU tridiagonal pivots and elementary TN factors prove backward Euler TN. The dimension-two determinant completes its exception. 192 exact rational cases and the 3x3 witness independently sanity-check arithmetic; no finite census is mistaken for a universal proof.

value.rationale: Ordered sign variation is a natural discrete Sturm-oscillation invariant for diffusion along a line. The result exactly separates ordinary pointwise Markov positivity and spectral stability from variation diminution, shows extra oscillations are unavoidable at arbitrarily small time step for all overimplicit parameters, gives a concrete witnessing vector, and sharply establishes three states as minimal. It is a universal qualitative boundary for a standard numerical time-step family rather than a tiny numerical gain.
